It then has another short blocked interval before the trace ends.

That long pause is consistent with sleeping or waiting: `clock_nanosleep` has a maximum observed duration of **30.087 s** in the trace, though the system-call statistics don’t identify that sample as belonging specifically to ticker. Scheduler wakeup-to-switch latency for ticker is far smaller (six samples, maximum **227 µs**), so these results don’t point to a scheduling delay. Without knowing whether the 30-second wait was expected, I can’t conclude ticker regressed or “got slow.”
